description.value: Manchu Wok is a Canadian Chinese fast food chain that has operated for over 45 years, founded in 1980 and now present in over 80 locations across three countries. This location sits in the food court at Metropolis at Metrotown, one of Metro Vancouver's largest shopping malls. Cyclists can expect quick counter-service combos with choices of rice or noodle base and a variety of wok-fired entrées including vegetable options.
